.github/actions/update-example/action.ym:
name: Generate and commit one example
description: Generate once per India-calendar day and push only the generated folder.
inputs:
  slot:
    description: Example number (1, 2 or 3)
    required: true
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Generate validated example
      shell: bash
      env:
        EXAMPLE_SLOT: ${{ inputs.slot }}
      run: node scripts/generate-update.mjs "$EXAMPLE_SLOT"
    - name: Commit and push
      uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@4a55954c782fc1ea30b9056cd3e7a2b40ca8887d # v7
      with:
        commit_message: 'chore(auto): update generated example ${{ inputs.slot }}/3'
        file_pattern: Project_github1/example-${{ inputs.slot }}.js
        commit_user_name: Synergicvans
        commit_user_email: 91491055+Synergicvans@users.noreply.github.com
        commit_author: Synergicvans <91491055+Synergicvans@users.noreply.github.com>
.github/workflows/daily-update.yml:
name: AutoGitUpdater

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 13 * * *' # 7:00 PM India time
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: autogitupdater-daily
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout current default branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - name: Check generator
        run: node --test tests/generate-update.test.mjs
      - name: Update 1 of 3
        uses: ./.github/actions/update-example
        with:
          slot: '1'
      - name: Update 2 of 3
        uses: ./.github/actions/update-example
        with:
          slot: '2'
      - name: Update 3 of 3
        uses: ./.github/actions/update-example
        with:
          slot: '3'
scripts/update.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Compatibility entry point. The workflow uses generate-update.mjs directly.
node scripts/generate-update.mjs "${1:-1}"
